note: A hand-kept checklist of what each assistant publicly offers, from their own product pages and the comparison articles linked below. Products change often: treat 'yes' and 'no' as a starting point and confirm in the product before you build. 'unknown' means it was not confirmed.

sources.title: ChatGPT vs Claude vs Perplexity vs Gemini, April 2026 (AIMagicx)
The Complete Guide to Choosing AI Platforms in 2026 (First AI Movers)

features.name: Streams the answer as it is written
features.how: Stream tokens to the page as they arrive.

features.name: Formats answers (headings, tables, code blocks)
features.how: Render Markdown safely, with a copy button on code blocks.

features.name: Copy an answer or a code block in one click
features.how: Add a copy button to each answer and each code block.

features.name: Stop an answer part-way
features.how: Send a cancel signal to the running turn.

features.name: Regenerate an answer
features.how: Drop the last answer and ask again.

features.name: Edit an earlier message and continue from there
features.how: Rewind the conversation to that message and resend.

features.name: Thumbs up / down on an answer
features.how: Send the rating to the Auditor, which turns thumbs-down into a diagnosed failure.

features.name: Suggested follow-up questions
features.how: Ask the model for three short follow-ups after each answer.

features.name: Search past conversations
features.how: Full-text search over stored messages.

features.name: Export or share a conversation
features.how: Download a conversation as Markdown.

features.name: Dictate a message by voice
features.how: Use the browser's speech recognition where it exists.

features.name: Attach documents (PDF, Word, text)
features.how: Extract text on the server and let the model search it.

features.name: Understand images
features.how: Send images to a vision-capable model.

features.name: Web search with linked sources
features.how: Search tool plus a page-reading tool; cite as links.

features.name: Deep research mode (multi-step, cited report)
features.how: A longer tool loop that plans sub-questions and writes a sourced report.

features.name: Remembers facts about you across chats
features.how: A small notes store the model can read and write, with a page to review it.

features.name: Projects / workspaces with their own files and instructions
features.how: Group chats under a project that carries shared files and a custom instruction.

features.name: Runs code or analyses data
features.how: Needs a sandbox for running code safely. Do not run model code on the host.

features.name: Side panel for documents and live previews
features.how: Render HTML in a sandboxed frame next to the chat.

features.name: Connects to your apps (mail, calendar, drive)
features.how: Support MCP servers as extra tools.

features.name: Generates images
features.how: Call an image model. Not core to an auditing assistant.

features.name: Switch model from the chat window
features.how: List the models whose keys are present and let the person pick.

features.name: Light and dark themes
features.how: Follow the system setting, with a toggle.

features.name: Shows the steps it took (searches, tool calls)
features.how: Show each tool call as a chip with its result.

unique.name: Every answer is recorded as a trace you can open
unique.detail: Consumer assistants do not let you inspect the steps behind an answer.

unique.name: Each failure is given a likely cause and a fix to try
unique.detail: A thumbs-down becomes a diagnosed failure, not just a number.

unique.name: A real failure becomes a regression test
unique.detail: Replay it against a new version before it ships.

unique.name: Changes go out through a canary and a human-approved gate, with rollback
unique.detail: Switching models is a reviewed release, not a silent change.

unique.name: The same questions asked of several models, with pass rates and intervals
unique.detail: Shows when another model would answer your questions better.
